sections.content:
Merchandising Admin Assistant
We’re after the right person to help ensure we have the right product, at the right price, at the right time. In this position you’ll play a key role in delivering that product through its entire life cycle, starting with supporting purchase order creation to proactively monitoring and trading stock.
Passenger’s culture embraces diversity and celebrates good work. We’re looking for those who share our passion for protecting the planet while building something unique and authentic. We’re passionate about escapism, connection and the wellbeing of ourselves and our environment.
You are commercial, agile and a proactive team player. You are highly organized, analytical and a confident communicator with a passion for trading. You are ready to work in a fun, fast paced environment and be part of the tribe driving one of the UK’s fastest growing companies forward!

sections.heading: Responsibilities:
sections.content:
Purchase Order Coordination
Create pre-order POs.
Create repeat POs.
Expose any product listing omissions.
Work closely with internal teams to maintain strong visibility of intake.
Take a supporting role in preparing the weekly trade summary, reacting to the data and completing tasks to improve performance further, including third party brands.
Support weekly review of visual merchandising of website.
Manage cross merchandising, optimising trading performance and customer experience.
Support in reviewing and updating product level forecasts.
Review offline products and expose to relevant individuals.
Support AM with conducting comparative shopping reports to understand our product, price and service proposition vs key competitors.
Interact with other teams to improve seasonal performance and drive best practices.
Partner with the Trade team and wider teams to create customer focused seasonal strategies, incl. lessons learnt, that drive profitable growth and efficiency.
Conduct sizing analysis to aid high sell through and customer satisfaction.
Conduct detailed ad-hoc analysis when required on specific products/product groups.
Ensure understanding of market landscape through use of price analysis tools, Google Analytics, Trends, market and customer insight.
Review linking, to ensure customers know feedback on products they are interested in.

sections.heading: Your Current Skills and Abilities:
sections.content:
Experience in or education related to merchandising or related fields 
Good commercial judgment, reasoning and decision-making skills.
Strong organisational skills, with proven ability to meet deadlines.
Excellent analytical and spreadsheet skills (we use G Suite).
Resilience, adaptability and the ability to manage change.

sections.heading: What We Offer:
sections.content:
A culture of empowerment, freedom, flexibility, and trust
Exciting career development possibilities
Escapism is serious business for us, we practise what we preach
Our HQ is in the New Forest, 5 minutes from the sea. We have a bar, pizza ovens and regular social meetups
Typical Hours: 8.30am - 5.30pm 5 days a week. We understand we all have lives, so please talk to us about the flexibility you need to be successful in this role, including part time working.
The hybrid role will require you to be in the office approximately 2 days per month to attend company wide ‘Cabin Sessions’ plus additional days for key meetings as agreed with Head of Trade
Annual Leave: 25 days plus bank holidays + a day for your birthday
Very generous staff discount and Friends and Family discount 
Private Medical Insurance for you and your dependants 
Annual Volunteering Day to support causes that matter to you

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.content: If you are a passionate and dedicated individual who shares our commitment to the outdoors, sustainability, and creating exceptional products, we would love to hear from you. Please send your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you’re the perfect fit for this role.

sections.heading: Equal Employment Opportunity
sections.content: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other factors.
